Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 3

“Know that one to be a perpetual renouncer who neither hates nor desires. Free from dualities, mighty-armed one, such a person is easily released from bondage.”

Renunciation is redefined as an inner condition rather than an outward arrangement. By this measure someone in armour can be a renunciate, and someone in a forest may not be.
